title: Salesforce standard objects the Younium connector meets: Account, Contact, Opportunity, OpportunityLineItem, Product2, PricebookEntry, Order, OrderItem, Contract
status_note: Written on 1 November 2026 after public knowledge of the Salesforce standard objects (the Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform), in our own words; the reference pages could not be opened from the session that wrote the pack (developer.salesforce.com is outside its allowed network), so the claims are unverified until someone opens them. Table names are the objects' API names in upper case (OPPORTUNITYLINEITEM); columns are the API field names read without case or underscores (AccountId and account_id alike). Custom fields (__c) and the connector's own package objects are not described.

variants.api_v2: Salesforce standard objects as the Object Reference describes them, landed one table per object with the API field names (a Fabric Salesforce connector, mirroring or a pipeline). Not verified against any org.

sf_object_reference.title: Salesforce: Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform (standard objects and their fields)
sf_object_reference.note: Unverified: developer.salesforce.com could not be reached from the session that wrote this pack (1 November 2026; outside its allowed network). Written after public knowledge of the standard objects.

sf_opportunitylineitem.title: Salesforce Object Reference: OpportunityLineItem (OpportunityId, PricebookEntryId, Product2Id, Quantity, UnitPrice, TotalPrice)
sf_opportunitylineitem.note: Unverified: not reachable from the writing session (1 November 2026). A web search result of that day quoting the page: OpportunityId is required; pricing is set through PricebookEntryId; Product2Id is a read-only reference to the Product2 (API 30.0 and later); an opportunity has line items only when it has a Pricebook2.

sf_id_field_type.title: Salesforce: the ID field type (15-character case-sensitive ids; the 18-character case-safe form the API returns)
sf_id_field_type.note: Unverified: not reachable from the writing session (1 November 2026). Web search results of that day (third-party pages pointing at this page): the user interface shows 15 case-sensitive characters, the API returns 18 whose first 15 are the same, the last three a checksum that makes the id safe where case is ignored; CASESAFEID(Id) converts.

tables.name: ACCOUNT
tables.en: Salesforce Account (a company, or a person in orgs with person accounts)
tables.sv: Salesforce-konto (ett företag, eller en person där personkonton används)
tables.note: ID has 18 characters through the API. The Younium connector sends Accounts to Younium and writes this ID into the Younium account's External CRM Id. PARENT_ID names the parent account in a hierarchy. In an org with person accounts an Account row can be a person (IS_PERSON_ACCOUNT), and its name is then personal data.

tables.name: CONTACT
tables.note: A contact belongs to one account (ACCOUNT_ID; it can be empty for private contacts). Personal data throughout.

tables.name: OPPORTUNITY
tables.en: Opportunity (a deal in the pipeline; the Younium connector sends it to Younium as the order)
tables.sv: Affärsmöjlighet (en affär i pipelinen; Younium-kopplingen skickar den till Younium som order)

amounts.currency: CURRENCY_ISO_CODE when the org has multi-currency enabled; otherwise the org's corporate currency, and there is no currency column

tables.note: When an opportunity has products (OPPORTUNITYLINEITEM), AMOUNT is the sum of their TOTAL_PRICE and is read-only: joined with its line items the amount is repeated once per line. STAGE_NAME and IS_WON/IS_CLOSED say where the deal stands; the connector maps the stage to a Younium status by hand.

tables.name: OPPORTUNITYLINEITEM
tables.en: Opportunity product (a line of an opportunity: a price book entry, quantity and price)

amounts.currency: the opportunity's currency (OPPORTUNITY.CURRENCY_ISO_CODE in a multi-currency org)

tables.note: The product is chosen through a price book entry (PRICEBOOK_ENTRY_ID); PRODUCT2_ID is derived from it and read-only. UNIT_PRICE is a price, TOTAL_PRICE = QUANTITY times UNIT_PRICE (minus discount) the amount. The Younium connector sends these as Opportunity Products to Younium.

tables.name: PRODUCT2
tables.note: PRODUCT_CODE is free text and not enforced unique. How the Younium connector matches a Younium product to a Product2 (a code, an external id field of its package) is not in what we could read.

tables.name: PRICEBOOKENTRY
tables.en: Price book entry (a product's price in one price book and currency)
tables.sv: Prislistepost (en produkts pris i en prislista och valuta)
tables.note: One row per product, price book (PRICEBOOK2_ID; the Pricebook2 object is not described here) and, in a multi-currency org, currency. UNIT_PRICE is a list price, not an amount.

tables.name: ORDER
tables.en: Order (an agreement to provide products; may come from an opportunity and sit under a contract)
tables.sv: Order (ett avtal att leverera produkter; kan komma från en affärsmöjlighet och ligga under ett kontrakt)

amounts.currency: CURRENCY_ISO_CODE when multi-currency is enabled, otherwise the org's corporate currency

tables.note: TOTAL_AMOUNT is the sum of the order products' TOTAL_PRICE: joined with ORDERITEM it is repeated once per line. ORDER_NUMBER is an auto-number. The Younium connector described in the sources sends opportunities, not orders; an org that uses Orders has them beside the opportunities.

tables.name: ORDERITEM
tables.en: Order product (a line of an order)
tables.note: Like the opportunity product: the product comes through PRICEBOOK_ENTRY_ID, PRODUCT2_ID is derived and read-only.

tables.name: CONTRACT
tables.en: Contract (a business agreement with an account; orders and opportunities can refer to it)
tables.note: CONTRACT_NUMBER is an auto-number. START_DATE and CONTRACT_TERM (months) give the term; STATUS the state. A Salesforce contract is not a Younium subscription: the subscription lives in Younium and is linked, if at all, through the account.

relationships.condition: The account hierarchy, a reference of a table to itself; listed so that the column is not read as anything else.
Derived from the price book entry and read-only; the same product the entry names.
Derived from the price book entry and read-only.

traps.title: Opportunity.Amount and Order.TotalAmount are sums of their lines
traps.text: With products on the opportunity, AMOUNT is the sum of the line items' TOTAL_PRICE and read-only; ORDER.TOTAL_AMOUNT likewise over ORDERITEM. Summing a header amount over a join with its lines counts it once per line. UNIT_PRICE on a line or a price book entry is a price, not an amount.

traps.title: The product is reached through the price book entry
traps.text: A line item names a PricebookEntry, which names the Product2 and the price book. PRODUCT2_ID on the line is a derived, read-only copy of the entry's product; the two must agree, and a plan should read one of them as the link, not both as independent facts.

traps.title: A currency column exists only in a multi-currency org
traps.text: CURRENCY_ISO_CODE appears on Account, Opportunity, Order and PricebookEntry only when the org has multi-currency enabled; without it every amount is in the org's corporate currency and there is no column to join with the Younium account's CURRENCY.
